question: The base-nine representation of the number \(N\) is \(27{,}006{,}000{,}052_9.\) What is the remainder when \(N\) is divided by \(5?\)
solution:
The useful observation is that \(9\equiv-1\pmod5\). Consequently, an even power of \(9\) is congruent to \(1\), and an odd power is congruent to \(-1\), modulo \(5\).

Expanding the nonzero base-nine digits by place value gives
\[
N=2\cdot9^{10}+7\cdot9^9+6\cdot9^6+5\cdot9+2.
\]
Replacing each power by its congruent value, we get
\[
N\equiv2-7+6-5+2=-2\equiv3\pmod5.
\]
Since \(-2+5=3\), the remainder is \(\boxed{3}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
